mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity, potentially leading to electrolyte imbalances that may affect cardiac conduction and ivabradine efficacy; additive QT prolongation risk exists with both agents.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium), and cardiac rhythm; adjust ivabradine dosing if renal impairment develops during amikacin therapy.
